name: Rochelle Kate Ongsiako Haas
office: San Gabriel Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Rochelle Kate Ongsiako Haas is a member of the San Gabriel Unified School District Governing Board, appointed in 2018 and reappointed in 2022. She is a therapist and has worked as a middle school math and science teacher. She says the district's top needs are expanding wellness programs and school-based mental health resources, and closing the achievement gap by supporting English learners and students with learning differences. She says retaining teachers requires fair pay and support, since providing subsidized housing is not feasible.
